title: Event tracking spec — Lifecycle Growth activation funnel (signup → API key → first request → 100k tokens)
content:
Last updated: 2026-02-06 (Nadia)
Owners: Nadia Rahman (taxonomy), Logan Wright (platform), Mei Lin (datasets), Dylan Brooks (console instrumentation)
Consumers: Growth/Marketing (Ben Carter, Tyler Benson), Product (Marissa Cole), Observability (Allison Grant/Sergio Costa)


1) Purpose / scope
This doc defines the event taxonomy + required properties for the Lifecycle Growth Experiments sprint (Q1 2026):
- Activation funnel measurement: signup → API key created → first successful request → first 100k tokens (within 7 days)
- Experiment attribution: email onboarding v2, in-console nudges, retargeting audiences (UTM capture)
- Guardrails: dedupe correctness, minimal PII, predictable joins for funnel dashboards

In-scope surfaces:
- Console web app (API key creation, onboarding checklist/nudges, preferences)
- Hosted API gateway / inference edge (request success, streaming first token, token counts)
- Experiment cohort assignment service / feature flags

Out of scope:
- Detailed lifecycle email vendor event mapping (opens/clicks are handled by vendor + Marketing Ops). We only track “email send triggered” and “CTA landing UTM attribution” when user comes back.


2) Event naming + versioning conventions
2.1 Prefix and casing
All events for this project use prefix: ri_ (Redwood Inference)
Event names are snake_case.

Examples:
- ri_signup
- ri_api_key_created
- ri_inference_request_succeeded

2.2 Schema evolution
- Additive changes only during sprint (new optional properties OK).
- Breaking changes require a new event name OR explicit schema_version bump + dual emit period.

2.3 Required common properties (all events)
These properties MUST be present on every event below.
- event_id: globally unique UUID (generated at emission time). Used for dedupe in the warehouse.
- occurred_at: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC), when the user action happened (not when ingested).
- user_id: Redwood internal user UUID (null allowed for fully anonymous web visits; see UTM capture section).
- workspace_id: Redwood workspace/org UUID if applicable (null allowed at pre-workspace stages).
- source: one of [console_web, api_gateway, backend_job, sdk_typescript, sdk_python, docs_site]
- environment: one of [prod, staging] (NOTE: dashboards only include prod).
- schema_version: string (start at “2026-01-0”).

Strongly recommended on all events:
- request_id: string (for API/gateway events; use our existing request id when available)
- region: string (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1)
- client_ip_hash: salted hash (if needed for abuse detection; do not emit raw IP)

PII rule (important): no raw email, no API key, no prompt or completion text. Domain (from email) is allowed only as a normalized classification (e.g., enterprise_domain=true) produced server-side.


3) Identity + join strategy (how Growth will compute funnels)
Primary join keys:
- user_id (preferred)
- workspace_id (secondary for org-level metrics)

Anonymous pre-signup web events:
- We support utm capture without user_id via anonymous_id (cookie-based) but DO NOT include this in the activation funnel dashboards by default. It’s for marketing attribution only.

Standard funnel definition reference:
- Activation milestone 1: first successful request (ri_inference_request_succeeded)
- Activation milestone 2: first 100k tokens served within 7 days of signup (ri_token_milestone_reached where milestone=100k)


4) Dedupe + idempotency rules (critical)
Problem statement:
- We previously saw duplicate signup/activation emissions from console on refresh/back/fast navigation which inflated conversion rates. Fix was shipped in GitHub PR-28521; this doc codifies the rules.

4.1 Dedupe in the warehouse
- Primary dedupe key: event_id (must be unique).
- Secondary dedupe for “at-most-once semantic” events: (user_id, workspace_id, event_name, dedupe_key) where dedupe_key is defined per event below.

4.2 Emission-time idempotency (preferred)
Events that represent a state transition should be emitted from the authoritative backend service (or a backend-confirmed response) rather than pure client-side clicks.

4.3 Event-specific dedupe guidance
- ri_signup: emit once per user_id (dedupe_key=user_id). If multiple emits occur, keep earliest occurred_at.
- ri_api_key_created: emit once per api_key_id (dedupe_key=api_key_id). If key is deleted/recreated, that should be a new api_key_id.
- ri_inference_request_succeeded: do NOT dedupe by user_id (this is a high-volume event). Dedupe by request_id if retries can cause duplicates.
- ri_first_successful_request: derived or emitted once per user_id+workspace_id (dedupe_key=user_id|workspace_id). Prefer server-side derived as a materialized view, but we can emit for faster iteration during sprint.
- ri_token_milestone_reached: emit once per (workspace_id, milestone) within a rolling window (dedupe_key=workspace_id|milestone|window_start). See section 6.


5) Sampling policy
Sampling policy for activation funnel events:
- NO SAMPLING for these event types: ri_signup, ri_api_key_created, ri_experiment_assigned, ri_nudge_* events.
- API request events:
  - ri_inference_request_succeeded: no sampling for now (we need accurate TTFT + early funnel). If we hit volume constraints, we can sample AFTER the first 7 days post-signup cohort only, but that requires explicit sign-off from Growth + Observability.
  - ri_stream_first_token: no sampling for new users (first 7 days). Optional sampling for older cohorts if needed.

If sampling is introduced later:
- Include sample_rate property (float 0–1) and ensure downstream aggregations divide by sample_rate.


6) Event catalog (definitions + required properties)
Below is the draft catalog used by the dashboards and experiment readouts.

Legend:
- “Emitter”: where event is generated
- “When”: trigger condition
- “Required properties”: in addition to Common properties (section 2.3)


6.1 Signup / account creation
Event: ri_signup
Emitter: backend (auth service) triggered by successful account creation
When: user completes signup (email verified if that’s required in prod)
Required properties:
- signup_method: [email_password, google_oauth, github_oauth, sso] (if unknown, “unknown”)
- marketing_consent: [true,false,unknown]
- enterprise_domain: [true,false] (computed server-side)
Dedupe key: user_id
Notes:
- Do not emit from client; client can fire a “signup_submit_clicked” for UX debug but it’s out of scope for activation funnel.


6.2 Workspace created (optional but useful for dropoff analysis)
Event: ri_workspace_created
Emitter: backend
When: default workspace is created (auto or user-driven)
Required properties:
- workspace_plan_tier: [free, pro_trial, pro, enterprise_unknown]
- is_default_workspace: [true,false]
Dedupe key: workspace_id


6.3 API key creation
Event: ri_api_key_created
Emitter: backend (console calls API; event emitted after API returns success)
When: new API key is created
Required properties:
- api_key_id: UUID (NEVER emit raw key value)
- key_type: [user, service_account] (if applicable)
- created_via: [console, api, terraform, unknown]
- permissions_profile: string (e.g., “default”, “restricted_inference_only”)
Dedupe key: api_key_id


6.4 First successful request (high-level milestone)
Two options; we can support both for now:

A) Raw request success event (high volume)
Event: ri_inference_request_succeeded
Emitter: api_gateway (authoritative)
When: a request returns HTTP 2xx AND model execution is successful (no model_error)
Required properties:
- request_id: string
- model: string (canonical model slug, e.g., “llama-3.1-70b-instruct”) 
- endpoint: [chat_completions, completions, embeddings, rerank]
- input_tokens: integer (best effort; if unknown emit -1)
- output_tokens: integer (best effort)
- total_tokens: integer (best effort)
- latency_ms: integer (end-to-end)
- status_code: integer
- is_streaming: [true,false]
- sdk: [none, typescript, python, other]
- sdk_version: string (or “unknown”)
Dedupe key: request_id

B) Derived milestone event (low volume, easier funnel)
Event: ri_first_successful_request
Emitter: backend_job (daily or hourly) OR api_gateway emitting only when it detects “first for user/workspace”
When: first ri_inference_request_succeeded for (user_id, workspace_id)
Required properties:
- model: string (from the first successful request)
- endpoint: [chat_completions, completions, embeddings, rerank]
- time_since_signup_seconds: integer
- first_request_latency_ms: integer (optional; best effort)
Dedupe key: user_id|workspace_id
Implementation note:
- Preferred is derived in warehouse for long-term truth; during sprint we may also emit for speed (but must reconcile with derived numbers).


6.5 Streaming: time-to-first-token (TTFT)
Event: ri_stream_first_token
Emitter: api_gateway
When: first token is emitted on a streaming response
Required properties:
- request_id: string
- ttft_ms: integer
- model: string
- endpoint: [chat_completions, completions]
- input_tokens: integer (best effort)
- is_streaming: true
Dedupe key: request_id
Notes:
- If streaming is disabled, this event is not emitted.


6.6 Token milestone (100k within 7 days)
Event: ri_token_milestone_reached
Emitter: backend_job (aggregation job; avoid emitting on every request)
When: workspace crosses a cumulative token threshold within a defined window relative to signup
Required properties:
- milestone: [100k_tokens]
- window_type: [post_signup]
- window_start_at: ISO timestamp
- window_end_at: ISO timestamp
- cumulative_total_tokens: integer (value at emit time)
- time_since_signup_seconds: integer (at threshold crossing)
Dedupe key: workspace_id|milestone|window_start_at
Implementation notes:
- Window definition for this sprint: 7 days post ri_signup.occurred_at (user-level) but computed at workspace level.
- If user has multiple workspaces, we count the first workspace created (default) unless Growth explicitly changes logic.
- This event is used for the “first 100k tokens within 7 days” KPI and should be stable.


6.7 Experiment assignment (email + console nudges)
Event: ri_experiment_assigned
Emitter: backend (feature flag/cohort service)
When: a user is assigned to an experiment cohort (including holdout)
Required properties:
- experiment_id: string (e.g., “lifecycle_growth_email_v2”, “lifecycle_growth_nudges_v1”)
- variant: string (e.g., “control”, “treatment_a”, “treatment_b”, “holdout”)
- assignment_unit: [user_id, workspace_id]
- assignment_source: [feature_flags, email_orchestrator, manual_backfill]
- assignment_reason: string (e.g., “signup_date>=2026-01-13”, “stalled_no_api_key_24h”)
Dedupe key: experiment_id|user_id (or workspace_id based on assignment_unit)
Notes:
- Assignment should be sticky and consistent across console + backend.
- Re-assignment should not happen unless experiment is explicitly restarted; if it does, emit a separate event ri_experiment_reassigned (out of scope for sprint unless needed).


6.8 Console onboarding nudges (impressions + interactions)
These events are owned by Console instrumentation (Dylan/Chloe). They are required to evaluate nudge CTR and completion.

Event: ri_nudge_impression
Emitter: console_web
When: nudge is rendered AND meets “viewable” threshold (>= 500ms in viewport)
Required properties:
- nudge_id: string (e.g., “create_api_key”, “run_first_request”, “enable_streaming”, “view_usage_dashboard”)
- nudge_version: string (copy/layout version; start “v1”)
- placement: string (e.g., “home_header”, “api_keys_empty_state”, “onboarding_checklist”) 
- eligible: [true,false] (should always be true if emitted)
- experiment_id: string (if behind a flag; else “none”)
- variant: string (if behind a flag; else “none”)
- page_path: string (e.g., “/console/home”)
Dedupe key: user_id|nudge_id|page_path|day
Notes:
- Dedupe by day to avoid spamming impressions on every rerender.

Event: ri_nudge_clicked
Emitter: console_web
When: user clicks primary CTA on a nudge
Required properties:
- nudge_id
- nudge_version
- placement
- cta_id: string (e.g., “primary”, “secondary”, “learn_more”)
- destination: string (e.g., “/console/api-keys/new”, “/docs/quickstart”, “code_snippet_modal”)
- page_path
Dedupe key: event_id only (clicks can legitimately happen multiple times)

Event: ri_nudge_dismissed
Emitter: console_web
When: user dismisses nudge
Required properties:
- nudge_id
- nudge_version
- placement
- dismissal_type: [x_button, not_now, auto_hidden_completed]
- page_path
Dedupe key: user_id|nudge_id|dismissal_type|day


6.9 Onboarding checklist completion (optional, but recommended)
Event: ri_onboarding_step_completed
Emitter: backend or console_web (prefer backend when completion depends on server state)
When: user completes a defined onboarding step
Required properties:
- step_id: string (e.g., “api_key_created”, “first_request_succeeded”, “enabled_streaming”, “viewed_usage_dashboard”)
- step_source_event: string (which underlying event triggered completion; e.g., ri_api_key_created)
- time_since_signup_seconds: integer
Dedupe key: user_id|step_id


6.10 UTM capture for retargeting + attribution (minimal)
Event: ri_utm_attributed
Emitter: docs_site OR console_web
When: landing page loads with utm params AND we can associate to a user within the same session
Required properties:
- utm_source: string
- utm_medium: string
- utm_campaign: string
- utm_content: string (optional; use “(none)” if absent)
- utm_term: string (optional; “(none)” if absent)
- landing_path: string
- anonymous_id: string (allowed)
Dedupe key: anonymous_id|utm_campaign|day
Notes:
- This is not used for activation conversion directly; it’s used for marketing ROI analysis.


7) Data quality checks (must-pass before ramp)
Checklist for each event type:
- [ ] Emitted in prod
- [ ] Has all common required properties
- [ ] occurred_at is UTC and not null
- [ ] event_id is UUID and unique
- [ ] user_id/workspace_id populated as expected (document null cases)
- [ ] Dedupe logic validated with a 24h replay sample
- [ ] No prohibited PII

Specific checks we will run (Mei + Nadia):
- Signup duplicates: count(ri_signup) / count(distinct user_id) should be ~1.00 (allow <= 1.02 to account for late arriving data).
- API key created duplicates: count / count(distinct api_key_id) should be ~1.00.
- Request success event volume: compare to gateway request logs (should match within 1–2% after filtering).
- Regional parity: validate eu-west-1 vs us-east-1 event arrival latency. (We had a “missing in one region” discrepancy previously; if it reappears, escalate to Logan.)


8) Implementation notes / who does what
8.1 Console (Dylan/Chloe)
- Emit ri_nudge_* events from the reusable nudge component.
- Use viewability threshold to prevent false impressions.
- Persist dismissal state (don’t re-emit impressions after dismissal unless spec says otherwise).

8.2 API gateway (Logan / platform)
- Emit ri_inference_request_succeeded and ri_stream_first_token as authoritative signals.
- Ensure request_id is stable across retries; if retries create new ids, include parent_request_id (optional).

8.3 Cohort/feature flags (Jada/Ethan/Benji)
- Emit ri_experiment_assigned at assignment time for every eligible user.
- Ensure holdout variant exists and is sticky.

8.4 Data platform (Mei)
- Build/verify derived tables/views:
  - activation_funnel_base (signup, workspace, api key, first success, 100k milestone)
  - nudge_performance (impressions/clicks/dismissals by cohort)
- Add alerting thresholds to catch sudden drops post-release (Sergio/Allison ownership).


9) Open questions (as of 2026-02-06)
1) “First 100k tokens” attribution level: user vs workspace.
   - Current proposal: workspace default, tied back to user via workspace_id.
   - Action: confirm with Growth (Ben) which is used in dashboards.

2) “First successful request” as emitted event vs derived metric.
   - Proposal: keep both during sprint; long-term rely on derived.
   - Action: Mei to mark emitted ri_first_successful_request as “experimental” in warehouse docs.

3) SDK attribution: do we reliably know sdk + version for all requests?
   - Proposal: best effort (header-based), fall back to “unknown”.


10) Change log
2026-01-10: Initial draft (Nadia). Added core funnel events and nudge events.
2026-01-22: Added dedupe guidance after duplicate signup issue discovered; linked PR-28521.
2026-01-30: Added token milestone aggregation event to stabilize 100k KPI.
2026-02-06: Tightened required common properties + clarified sampling (no sampling for new user cohort).
